title: Use three subagents IN PARALLEL, each creating exactly one f

messages.content: Use three subagents IN PARALLEL, each creating exactly one file inside /Users/vlad/projects/crs-progress/qa-scratch/p3probe/ : subagent 1 writes a.txt containing the single character A; subagent 2 writes b.txt containing the single character B; subagent 3 writes c.txt containing the single character C. Launch all three subagents in a single message via the Task tool so they run concurrently. Use the Write tool inside each subagent. Report back which files were written.

All three subagents ran concurrently and each wrote its file:

- `qa-scratch/p3probe/a.txt` → `A`
- `qa-scratch/p3probe/b.txt` → `B`
- `qa-scratch/p3probe/c.txt` → `C`

Each is 1 byte, no newline.
